content.value_statement: Vue Router bugs often come from guard flow, route params, and component lifecycle assumptions. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code focused patterns for safer Vue Router 4 implementations.
actual_capabilities: Explains when beforeEnter, beforeEach, and in-component guards run.
Shows async guard patterns with explicit returns and timeout handling.
Demonstrates route-param refresh patterns with watchers and onBeforeRouteUpdate.
Documents lazy-loaded route configuration for Vue Router 4 applications.
Highlights cleanup needs for routing without Vue Router.
limitations: Does not run or modify application code.
Does not validate project-specific auth or API logic.
Does not replace Vue Router documentation for every API option.
Examples are educational and may need adaptation to local routing structure.

use_cases.title: Fix guard redirects
use_cases.description: Diagnose login loops, missing returns, and guards that continue navigation too early.

use_cases.title: Review route lifecycle bugs
use_cases.description: Check stale data issues when users move between routes that reuse the same component.

use_cases.title: Plan production routing
use_cases.description: Ask an AI assistant to structure routes with lazy loading, auth metadata, nested routes, and catch-all handling.

prompt_templates.title: Explain a Router Issue
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain why this Vue Router behavior happens and identify the best pattern from this skill. Focus on guards, params, and lifecycle behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Navigation Guards
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Vue Router guards for missing returns, redirect loops, deprecated next usage, and async mistakes. Give prioritized fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Refactor Param Handling
prompt_templates.prompt: Help refactor a route component that shows stale data when params change. Compare watchers, onBeforeRouteUpdate, and keyed router views.

prompt_templates.title: Design Production Routing
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a production Vue Router 4 setup for my app. Include lazy-loaded views, auth metadata, nested routes, error routes, and guard strategy.

output_examples.input: A user says beforeEnter does not run when /orders/1 changes to /orders/2.
output_examples.output: The skill explains that beforeEnter does not run for param-only changes and recommends an in-component update guard.

output_examples.input: A user asks why an auth guard loops between dashboard and login.
output: Exclude the target route from the guard.
Return a clear navigation result for every branch.

output_examples.input: A user asks how to structure Vue Router for production.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends createRouter, history mode, named routes, lazy-loaded views, auth meta, nested settings, and a catch-all route.

best_practices: Use explicit returns in async guards so navigation outcomes are clear.
Handle route-param changes with watchers or in-component update guards.
Keep redirect targets excluded from guards that could send users back.
anti_patterns: Relying only on onMounted for data that depends on route params.
Calling legacy next callbacks multiple times or in only some branches.
Redirecting users without checking the destination route first.

faq.question: What Vue Router version does this skill target?
faq.answer: It targets Vue Router 4 patterns for Vue single-page applications.

faq.question: Can it fix route components automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance that an AI assistant or developer can apply to code.

faq.question: Does it cover beforeRouteEnter limitations?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains why component instance access is unavailable before navigation enters the route.

faq.question: Does it help with stale route-param data?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers watchers, onBeforeRouteUpdate, and keyed router views for reused components.

faq.question: Does it include production route setup advice?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes lazy-loaded routes, auth metadata, nested routes, history mode, and catch-all routes.

faq.question: Is this skill a replacement for official docs?
faq.answer: No. It is a focused troubleshooting guide for common mistakes and best-practice patterns.
